summary: Real Messenger Corporation, a Nasdaq-listed foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K disclosing it regained compliance with Nasdaq Listing Rule 5550(b)(1), the $2.5 million minimum stockholders equity requirement. Nasdaq staff issued the compliance letter dated October 6, 2026, following the Company's June 10, 2026 Form 6-K and supplemental submissions on October 2, 2026; the prior deficiency notice was received April 6, 2026. Nasdaq warned that failure to evidence compliance upon filing interim financial statements for the period ended September 30, 2026 could trigger delisting, with appeal rights to a Hearings Panel. Watch the Q3 interim filing as the pivotal compliance test.
